title: Can you see the sea?
excerpt: I traced 360 sight lines from every 1 km square of the UK. Standing on the bare ground, 26% of the land has the sea in view; from an upstairs window, 29%. The farthest square from any sea view is near Donington le Heath.
seo_description: From how much of the UK can you see the sea? Sight lines from every 1 km square: 26% of the land, standing on the ground.
header_alt: Title card on pale paper reading 'Can you see the sea?' beside a map of the UK with coastal areas in shades of blue by the distance to the nearest visible sea and inland areas in sand.
